title: Update curated drug dataset and add post-refresh verification with full-list rendering

requirements.summary: Update the curated drug dataset to be complete, up to date, type-safe, and deterministically deduplicated.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/data/curatedDrugDataset.ts` contains the updated complete dataset (no build/type errors).
All entries in the dataset conform to the `Drug` type (including valid `DrugStatus` and `DrugSource` variants).
Duplicate drug names are deterministically deduplicated using the existing `deduplicateDrugs` utility rules (banned > approved; newer date > older date).

file_operations.description: Update/expand `curatedDrugDataset` so every record includes required fields (`name`, `status`, `date`, `category` when known, `description`, `source`, `safetyInfo`) and aligns with `Drug`, `DrugStatus`, and `DrugSource` types. Ensure exported dataset is deterministically deduplicated using existing `deduplicateDrugs` rules (banned > approved; newer date > older date).

requirements.summary: Add a single-action refresh + verification workflow and show verification results in the Drug Database UI.
acceptanceCriteria: A single user action (or existing refresh action) triggers: (1) update/refresh of the drug dataset and (2) a verification step.
Verification checks at minimum: total count > 0, no empty `name` values, no invalid/missing `status`, and no duplicate drugs when normalized by the same rules used in the curated dataset.
The UI shows a clear success/failure outcome for verification, and on failure provides a human-readable summary (English) of what failed (e.g., duplicate count, invalid entries count).

file_operations.description: Create a client-side drug-list verification helper that can validate a `Drug[]` using the same normalization/deduplication rules as `frontend/src/data/curatedDrugDataset.ts` (e.g., use `normalizeDrugName` / `deduplicateDrugs`). It must report a boolean pass/fail plus an English summary including at least: total count, empty-name count, invalid/missing-status count, and duplicate-normalized-name count.

Add React Query hooks to support the post-refresh verification workflow: a mutation that calls the backend capability `refreshAndVerifyDrugTable()` and a query for `getLastDrugVerification()`. Ensure the mutation invalidates/refetches the drug list query (e.g., `['allDrugs']`) and the last verification query so the UI updates immediately after a refresh+verify completes.

Wire the existing Refresh user action to trigger refresh+verification (single action) by using the new mutation hook. After completion, run the client-side verification helper over the returned `allDrugs` (or the currently fetched list) and render a clear success/failure outcome in the UI. On failure, display a concise English summary of what failed (duplicate count, invalid entries count, etc.). Keep UI text in English and do not edit any files under `frontend/src/components/ui`.

requirements.summary: Ensure Drug Database renders the entire dataset per tab and uses pagination/virtualization so search, filters, CSV export, and details modal work across the full list.
acceptanceCriteria: The Drug Database module renders all items returned by the backend for each tab (All/Approved/Banned), without silently dropping items due to performance limits.
Search and category filtering operate over the full fetched dataset.
CSV export includes all currently filtered rows (not just the visible subset, if pagination/virtualization is used).
Drug details modal continues to open and display details for any item in the dataset.

file_operations.description: Implement a large-list UI strategy using client-side pagination (or virtualization) applied after full-list filtering: (1) compute `filteredDrugs` over the full fetched dataset, (2) derive `visibleDrugs` for rendering only (page slice), and (3) keep CSV export based on the full `filteredDrugs` (not the visible slice). Ensure the modal still opens for any rendered row and continues to show correct details.

Ensure Drug Database list-fetching hooks remain independent of profile-loading state and are configured to fetch the complete drug list (e.g., keep `useGetAllDrugs` enabled based on actor availability, with appropriate caching/stale times). If needed for UI correctness, add/select a dedicated query key for the all-drugs dataset used by the Drug Database module.
